messages.content:
You are a road-centerline reconstruction assistant for RC-style road-structure images.
The image shows lane_boundary/road_edge in orange-yellow and lane_divider in cyan-blue on a dark background.
The centerlines are not directly drawn; infer them from the visible road structure.
Use incoming traces only as continuity hints from already processed neighboring patches.
Return only valid JSON in the required schema, with start_type and end_type for every line.
Use cut for endpoints clipped by the patch boundary and inside for natural endpoints inside the patch.

<image>
This is a 256x256 RC road-structure patch.
Predict the road centerlines inside this patch only.

Incoming traces JSON:
[{"id":"L0","side":"left","points":[[-25,170],[-13,149],[-1,128]]},{"id":"L1","side":"left","points":[[-25,244],[-13,223],[-1,202]]},{"id":"T0","side":"top","points":[[96,-42],[84,-22],[72,-1]]},{"id":"T1","side":"top","points":[[138,-42],[126,-22],[114,-1]]}]

Each incoming trace has 1 to 3 points and is ordered from the previous patch interior toward the current patch boundary.
Incoming traces are continuity hints only; they may be incomplete or absent.
Return only valid JSON in this schema:
{"lines":[{"category":"centerline","start_type":"cut|inside","end_type":"cut|inside","points":[[x,y],[x,y]]}]}
All output points must be integers inside [0,255]. Do not output points outside the image.
